page_title: HEI 3-1 UNI | Heidenheim v Union Berlin 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Heidenheim players look gutted.
90+6' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
90+6' The Heidenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Christian Dingert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

90+5' Goal! Arijon Ibrahimovic sets up Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom left corner. 4:1.
90+3' The Union Berlin players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) coming on for Jan Schoppner.
87' Linus Guther (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
84' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Linus Guther (Union Berlin) replacing Alex Kral.
82' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' 3 - 1 That was a nice piece of skill by Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to fire a superb effort that goes into the top right corner. The score is 3:1.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Marvin Pieringer.
77' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Mathias Honsak and he is replaced by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim).
75' 2 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:1.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) will replace Stefan Schimmer.
69' Here is a change. Diogo Leite is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Livan Burcu (Union Berlin).
69' That will be all from Andras Schafer who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
68' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Diant Ramaj is prepared to thwart his effort.
66' Rough tackle by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) replaces Derrick Kohn.
62' Substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) on for Oliver Burke.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
55' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' A lofted cross from Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Heidenheim earn a corner.
50' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
46' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Heidenheim are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Christian Dingert blows his whistle. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play.
42' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
41' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) was too forceful with his tackle and Christian Dingert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
36' 2 - 0 GOAL! Patrick Mainka meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:0.

35' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is behind the touchline and Heidenheim will take a throw-in.
31' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
27' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
24' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and it's Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
13' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.

9' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Julian Niehues. The score is 1:0.
6' Heidenheim keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
2' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Heidenheim will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Christian Dingert.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
